summary: Fixed parsel/utils.py extract_regex so a named 'extract' group that did not participate in the match (e.g. an alternation like (?P<extract>foo)|(?P<bar>baz)) yields no string instead of None, which made w3lib crash; both shard tests (test_re in SelectorTestCase and SelectorTestCaseBytes) now pass. The last full-suite run showed 205 passed, 1 failed (tests/test_selector_csstranslator.py::UtilCss2XPathTest::test_css2xpath, a class-selector translation issue in csstranslator.py outside my share and not touched by this change), 2 skipped.
